title: The Journey of the Israelites
description: God's people were slaves in Egypt for 400 years. He sent Moses to lead them out, gave them his Law, and brought them to the Promised Land.

waypoints.title: Out of Egypt
waypoints.body: God heard his people's cries and sent Moses to lead them out of slavery in Egypt. He parted the Red Sea so they could escape, gave them his Law at Mount Sinai, and led them through the wilderness for forty years to the Promised Land.

waypoints.title: Be Strong and Courageous
waypoints.body: This week, when you feel scared or unsure about something new, remember Joshua 1:9 and say it out loud before you start.
